title.value: A Bill for an Act Relating to PFAS
title.provenance: A Bill for an Act Relating to PFAS

location.provenance: Be It Enacted by the People of the State of Oregon

pfas_definition.provenance: a perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance found in or on a covered product

type.provenance: A person may not manufacture, sell, offer for sale or distribute in or into this state a new covered product that contains an intentionally added perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance.

date.provenance: Sections 1 to 4 of this 2025 Act become operative on January 1, 2027.

who.provenance: A manufacturer of a covered product shall provide to a person that offers a covered product for sale in this state with a certificate of compliance stating that the covered product does not contain any intentionally added perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substances.

action.provenance: A person may not manufacture, sell, offer for sale or distribute in or into this state a new covered product that contains an intentionally added perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance.

products.provenance: A person may not manufacture, sell, offer for sale or distribute in or into this state a new covered product that contains an intentionally added perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance.

intentionally_added.provenance: A person may not manufacture, sell, offer for sale or distribute in or into this state a new covered product that contains an intentionally added perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance.
